ai.dynamic.analysisPromptDescription: English instruction used only by the context analyzer. Dialogue content is treated as untrusted data.
ai.dynamic.batchSizeDescription: Maximum number of older messages analyzed in one pass.
ai.dynamic.description: Compress older dialogue into durable facts, events, decisions, and open goals.
ai.dynamic.directMessagesDescription: Recent messages that remain verbatim in the generation prompt.
ai.dynamic.enabledDescription: Original messages stay in the database; only the direct prompt window is compacted.
ai.dynamic.modeDescription: Choose how the structured context is produced.
ai.dynamic.mode_hybridDescription: Use AI analysis with a local fallback when the request fails.
ai.dynamic.mode_localDescription: Deterministic extraction without an extra model request.
ai.dynamic.mode_providerDescription: Use the selected model for deeper dialogue analysis.
ai.dynamic.providerDescription: Choose a dedicated provider or reuse the provider of the active chat.
ai.dynamic.title: Dynamic context
ai.dynamic.triggerMessagesDescription: Run compaction after this many unsummarized messages accumulate.
ai.modules.noResultsDescription: Try a different module name or description.
ai.retry.description: Automatically retry temporary provider and network failures.
ai.retry.enabledDescription: Applies to generation, analysis, model discovery, health checks, and embeddings.
ai.retry.initialDelayDescription: Delay before the first retry. Later delays grow exponentially.
ai.retry.maxAttemptsDescription: Total attempts including the initial request.
ai.retry.title: Reliable requests
ai.semantic.archiveLimitDescription: Maximum number of covered messages kept in the semantic index per chat.
ai.semantic.archivedMessagesDescription: Index older messages that have already been covered by dynamic context.
ai.semantic.batchSizeDescription: Number of new memory items embedded in one API request.
ai.semantic.currentChatProvider: Active chat provider, if it supports embeddings
ai.semantic.description: Index useful long-term memories with embeddings and retrieve only what is relevant to the current turn.
ai.semantic.dynamicContextDescription: Index summaries, facts, events, decisions, and open goals.
ai.semantic.enabledDescription: Requires a provider with an embedding model configured in Telescope.
ai.semantic.noEmbeddingProviders: No provider has an embedding model configured yet. Add one in Telescope first.
ai.semantic.providerDescription: Provider used to index memories and embed the current query.
ai.semantic.rememberedMessagesDescriptio: Index messages explicitly marked as important.
ai.semantic.thresholdDescription: Higher values are stricter and return fewer memories.
ai.semantic.title: Semantic memory
ai.semantic.topKDescription: Maximum number of the most relevant memories added to a prompt.
settingsScreen.interfaceChatBehaviorAndS: Interface, chat behavior, and settings for this device.
settingsScreen.parametersAndModulesForTh: Application parameters and optional AI modules for this device.
ai.contextBudget.title: Token economy
ai.contextBudget.description: Aggressively reduce paid input context with local, deterministic rules before every generation.
ai.contextBudget.enabledDescription: Enables optional aggressive rules: direct-history budgeting, compact system framing, selective Worldbook activation, and a priority-aware system prompt target.
ai.contextBudget.maxCharactersDescriptio: Approximate character budget for conversation history sent to the model.
ai.contextBudget.preserveRecentMessagesD: Newest messages that remain even when they exceed the history target.
ai.repetitionGuard.title: Repetition guard
ai.repetitionGuard.description: Remind the model not to recycle distinctive wording and patterns from its recent replies.
ai.repetitionGuard.enabledDescription: Adds a compact anti-repetition rule. Reply excerpts are included only when those replies have already fallen outside the direct history sent to the model.
ai.repetitionGuard.recentAssistantMessag: How many recent assistant replies may be considered when looking for older replies no longer present in direct history.
ai.repetitionGuard.maxCharactersPerMessa: Maximum excerpt size for an older assistant reply only when that reply is no longer already visible in direct history.
ai.responseCleanup.title: Response cleanup
ai.responseCleanup.description: Apply conservative local cleanup after generation without another AI request.
ai.responseCleanup.enabledDescription: Runs deterministic formatting cleanup before the assistant message is saved.
ai.responseCleanup.collapseBlankLinesDes: Keeps code fences intact while reducing oversized vertical gaps.
ai.responseCleanup.removeDuplicatedTailD: Drops an exact repeated final paragraph when a provider returns it twice.
ai.contextBudget.compactSystemPromptDesc: Uses a shorter equivalent CORE contract and compact section headers.
ai.contextBudget.selectiveWorldbookEntri: Keyworded entries are sent only when recent conversation text matches them. Entries without keywords remain eligible.
ai.contextBudget.worldbookScanMessagesDe: How many newest user/assistant messages are searched for entry keywords.
ai.contextBudget.maxWorldbookEntriesDesc: Caps selected entries per Worldbook after keyword matching; stronger matches win.
ai.contextBudget.maxSystemCharactersDesc: If the assembled system prompt is larger, lower-priority sections are omitted first. CRITICAL sections are never removed.
ai.contextBudget.presetsDescription: Apply a practical starting point; every value remains editable.
ai.contextBudget.alwaysOnSavings: Safe savings are always active: Worldbook keywords are never sent to the model, repeated prompt rules are deduplicated, remembered messages already present in direct history are not sent twice, and Repetition Guard does not duplicate replies the model can already see.
